note: Prices are the official US list price for one exam attempt (or the subscription for course certificates), taken from each provider's own page on the date above. Taxes, member discounts and other countries can differ. cost_usd is what the list sorts by: for monthly subscriptions it's the estimated total at about 10 hours a week. null = the provider doesn't publish one price.

certifications.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
certifications.prereq: No coding needed. Familiarity with AI/ML and AWS basics helps.
certifications.summary: Entry-level proof that you understand AI, ML and generative AI concepts and how AWS services use them.

certifications.name: AWS Certified AI Business Strategist
certifications.prereq: No coding required. Aimed at people who plan and lead AI initiatives.
certifications.summary: For managers and strategists: picking AI use cases, building the business case and leading adoption.

certifications.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate
certifications.prereq: About 1 year of experience building ML on AWS (SageMaker).
certifications.summary: Building, deploying and monitoring machine learning models on AWS.

certifications.name: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional
certifications.prereq: Hands-on experience building generative AI apps on AWS (Bedrock).
certifications.summary: Senior-level: designing and shipping production generative AI apps, agents and RAG on AWS.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals
certifications.cost_note: Microsoft lists the price on the exam page for your country.
certifications.prereq: None. Good first certification.
certifications.summary: Core AI and generative AI concepts and the Azure services that provide them.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate
certifications.cost_note: Microsoft says associate exams typically cost US$165; check the exam page for your country.
certifications.prereq: Developer experience (Python or C#) and Azure basics.
certifications.summary: Building AI apps and agents on Azure. Successor to the retired Azure AI Engineer Associate.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate
certifications.cost_note: Microsoft says associate exams typically cost US$165. Free yearly renewal online.
certifications.prereq: Some experience with Power BI and data.
certifications.summary: Preparing, modeling and visualizing data in Power BI dashboards and reports.

certifications.name: Google Cloud Generative AI Leader
certifications.cost_note: Free prep learning path on Google Skills Boost.
certifications.prereq: None. Made for non-technical professionals.
certifications.summary: For leaders and non-technical staff: what generative AI can do and how to adopt it responsibly.

certifications.name: Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer
certifications.prereq: 3+ years of industry experience, including 1+ year on Google Cloud.
certifications.summary: Designing, building and running production ML systems on Google Cloud.

certifications.name: Google AI Essentials
certifications.cost_note: 7-day free trial (US/Canada). Under 5 hours, so usually one month.
certifications.prereq: None.
certifications.summary: Short, practical intro to using AI tools at work, writing prompts and using AI responsibly.

certifications.name: Google AI Professional Certificate
certifications.cost_note: About 8 one-hour courses, so usually one month.
certifications.prereq: No AI experience needed.
certifications.summary: Using AI for research, writing, planning and analysis in everyday work.

certifications.name: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
certifications.cost_note: About 240 hours: roughly 6 months (≈ $294) at 10 hours a week, or 3 months (≈ $147) at 20.
certifications.prereq: No experience or degree required.
certifications.summary: Job-ready entry into data analysis: spreadsheets, SQL, Tableau and R.

certifications.name: Machine Learning Specialization
certifications.cost_note: About 2 months (≈ $98) at 10 hours a week.
certifications.prereq: Basic coding and high-school math.
certifications.summary: Andrew Ng's foundational course in machine learning: regression, neural networks, trees and recommenders.

certifications.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
certifications.cost_note: About 4 months (≈ $196) at 10 hours a week. Financial aid available.
certifications.prereq: Working knowledge of Python and Jupyter, high-school math.
certifications.summary: Hands-on deep learning, PyTorch/Keras and generative AI engineering.

certifications.name: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Generative AI LLMs
certifications.prereq: Basic understanding of LLMs and Python.
certifications.summary: Foundations of developing, integrating and maintaining LLM-based applications.

certifications.name: Databricks Certified Machine Learning Associate
certifications.prereq: Some hands-on ML work in Databricks.
certifications.summary: Basic machine learning tasks on the Databricks platform.

certifications.name: Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate
certifications.prereq: Some hands-on experience building LLM apps in Databricks.
certifications.summary: Designing and building LLM and RAG applications with Databricks tools.

certifications.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure AI Foundations Associate
certifications.cost_note: Oracle offers the learning path and exam free.
certifications.prereq: None.
certifications.summary: Free introduction to AI, ML and generative AI concepts on Oracle Cloud.

certifications.name: CompTIA Data+
certifications.prereq: CompTIA recommends 1.5–2 years working with data.
certifications.summary: Vendor-neutral data analysis: data mining, visualization, governance and basic statistics.

certifications.name: IAPP Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP)
certifications.prereq: None required. Best with some privacy, legal, risk or compliance background.
certifications.summary: Managing AI risk, regulation (like the EU AI Act) and responsible AI programs.

certifications.name: PMI Certified Professional in Managing AI (PMI-CPMAI)
certifications.cost_note: Sold as a bundle with a 21-hour prep course; PMI doesn't list one price on the page.
certifications.prereq: Project or team experience helps.
certifications.summary: Running AI and data projects with PMI's six-phase CPMAI method.
